//: The data scripts get a project of their own rather than being added to the gateway's.
Two reasons, and the second is the one that matters. Type-aware linting needs every linted file
to belong to some tsconfig, and the gateway's deliberately does not include these — the scripts
are run by hand with tsx and are not part of the application. Leaving them outside entirely put
them on typescript-eslint's `allowDefaultProject` list, which is capped at 8 files and they are 9,
so the tenth to appear would have failed the whole lint run for the whole repo.
The other reason: adding them to the gateway's project would have put 9 scripts with real type
errors inside `turbo run typecheck`, which is a different piece of work from this one. They are
typechecked on their own terms here, and that is where the errors are now visible rather than
